name: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
intention: Courage · release · protection as an intention
text:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
meaning: We honour the three-eyed one who nourishes life. As a ripe fruit is released from its stem, may we be released from bondage and move towards the deathless.
purpose: A Vedic prayer to Rudra, widely used as a prayer for protection, strength and release from fear.
supports: Facing uncertainty; reflecting on mortality and impermanence; courage during transitions; spiritual resilience.
when: During meditation, a difficult transition, or a period when courage and steadiness are needed.
note: This is not a guarantee of healing, protection from death or recovery from illness. It is a spiritual prayer. The final words are commonly read as a request for liberation, not a denial of human vulnerability.
